keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Freddie Draper (Lincoln City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half begins Watford 0, Lincoln City 0.
Goal! Watford 1, Lincoln City 0. Stephy Mavididi (Watford) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Myron Boadu.
Ben House (Lincoln City) is shown the yellow card.
Stephy Mavididi (Watford) is shown the yellow card.
Kévin Keben (Watford) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Watford. Mamadou Doumbia replaces Myron Boadu.
Substitution, Watford. Krépin Diatta replaces Omar Haktab Traoré.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Rob Street replaces Callum Elder.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Reeco Hackett replaces Chiedozie Ogbene.
Substitution, Watford. Branimir Mlacic replaces Othmane Maamma.
Substitution, Watford. Martín Payero replaces Stephy Mavididi.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Tom Hamer replaces Daniel Oyegoke.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Adam Reach replaces Deji Elerewe.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Dom Jefferies replaces Tom Bayliss.
Branimir Mlacic (Watford) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Watford. Amin Nabizada replaces Iker Bravo.
Edo Kayembe (Watford) is shown the yellow card.
Sonny Bradley (Lincoln City) is shown the yellow card.
Hector Kyprianou (Watford) is shown the yellow card.
